content.title: Autonomous Packing Recovery | Ordered Assembly, Disruption and Closure
content.summary: A field equipment case packs five tools, survives one magnetic lift and restores the verified inventory before closure. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One fixed container, one stable room or table and a countable set of objects establish the baseline. + Each object follows a visible one-at-a-time path into one persistent compartment before the next object moves. + A complete packed state is visibly verified before one bounded disruption occurs. + The disruption may displace objects but cannot replace, duplicate or erase the container or inventory. + Recovery retraces displaced relations and ends with the same container closed once in a stable frame.
quick_start.recommended_input: Establish one original forest-green field case open on a workshop table with a folded grey map, copper cable, blue gloves, amber meter and cream jacket arranged in five fixed zones around it. The amber meter locks into the central foam cutout and the cream jacket folds across the top, proving a complete packed baseline before any disturbance. Reverse only the displaced paths so every object returns to its verified compartment; close the same case once and hold the exact small label "FIELD READY" without adding or removing equipment.
required_anchors: One fixed container, one stable room or table and a countable set of objects establish the baseline.
Each object follows a visible one-at-a-time path into one persistent compartment before the next object moves.
The disruption may displace objects but cannot replace, duplicate or erase the container or inventory.
Recovery retraces displaced relations and ends with the same container closed once in a stable frame.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A field equipment case packs five tools, survives one magnetic lift and restores the verified inventory before closure. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 固定房间、床面和旅行箱的注册关系，先逐件建立衣物从散置状态到分区入箱的可见路径；装满后用一次空间扰动打散局部秩序，再让同一批物件沿可追踪路径恢复，并以同一旅行箱完整闭合收尾。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One fixed container, one stable room or table and a countable set of objects establish the baseline.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One fixed container, one stable room or table and a countable set of objects establish the baseline."

invariants.rule: Each object follows a visible one-at-a-time path into one persistent compartment before the next object moves.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Each object follows a visible one-at-a-time path into one persistent compartment before the next object moves."

invariants.rule: A complete packed state is visibly verified before one bounded disruption occurs.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "A complete packed state is visibly verified before one bounded disruption occurs."

invariants.rule: The disruption may displace objects but cannot replace, duplicate or erase the container or inventory.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "The disruption may displace objects but cannot replace, duplicate or erase the container or inventory."

invariants.rule: Recovery retraces displaced relations and ends with the same container closed once in a stable frame.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "Recovery retraces displaced relations and ends with the same container closed once in a stable frame."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
